system.description:
Standard Power Progression — 4 Basic, 3 Intermediate, 3 Advanced. You must take the levels of a Discipline in order (all Basic before Intermediate, etc.). Powers from other sourcebooks are grouped under "Expanded Options" in the compendium.

  • Basic (4): Eyes of the Earth, Repel the Angry Dead, Roots of Power, See the Dead
  • Intermediate (3): Command the Freshly Dead, Course of the Beast, Heart of the Wood
  • Advanced (3): Army of Souls, Walk the Road of Shadows, Way of the Stone

Base rating-tracker for the Thaumaturgy Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
